name: Dundalk Leisurecraft Granby 2-3 Person Outdoor Cabin Sauna
description: Introducing the Canadian Timber Granby Sauna - Where Comfort and Craftsmanship Converge! Unveil the luxury of personalized relaxation with the Canadian Timber Granby Sauna, a beautifully crafted sauna designed for 2-3 people. Made from premium Canadian Eastern White Cedar, this sauna offers a seamless blend of elegance, durability, and warmth that enriches any space. Imagine a soothing retreat where the gentle warmth of the sauna surrounds you, melting away the day's stresses and rejuvenating your mind and body. The Granby Sauna brings this experience to life, offering a serene haven for personal relaxation or shared moments with loved ones. Key Features Handcrafted Eastern White Cedar Sustainably sourced Eastern White Cedar is known for its natural decay resistance, insulation, and a lovely cedar aroma that enhances the sauna experience. Two-Tier Bench System A sturdy two-tier bench along the back wall provides both upper and lower seating options, ideal for a comfortable and customizable sauna session. 28 Gauge Black Steel Roof The black matte steel roof adds durability, shielding your sauna from the elements and extending its lifespan. Window in Door A 5mm bronze tempered window on the solid cedar door lets in natural light, creating a welcoming ambiance while preserving privacy. Videos Warranty The Canadian Timber Collection by Dundalk LeisureCraft Inc. saunas are warranted against defects in materials and workmanship under normal/residential use for a period of three (3) years, as applicable, from the date of receipt of the product. This warranty does not apply to normal wear and tear and/or natural weather conditions. This warranty does not cover regular required maintenance of the sauna, (eg. Tightening bands on the barrels, cleaning or staining the sauna) refer to your sauna assembly manual for maintenance guidelines. This warranty does not cover misuse or negligence and the manufacturer and associated retailers are not liable for any injury or damage caused by the product. This warranty is a parts-only warranty and any service or labor costs would not be considered part of the 3-year warranty.
